rows.text: press release: Q2 profit doubles to Rs 6,187 cr, EBITDA up 83% YoY (per the filing's own headline).
NRC grants under an options-to-purchase-securities scheme (filing text not reviewed in full this pass).
posts record Q2 FY27 aluminium production of **649 kt** (+5% YoY) and alumina production of **895 kt** (+37% YoY).
Orissa High Court **dismissed its writ petition** challenging the bauxite linkage policy; the company is reviewing the judgment and its legal options.
